name: boros energy

winrate_basis.why: no head-to-head winrate exists for Modern in any source this repo can reach: statistics_matchups returns zero rows for the format, statistics_archetypes carries no winrate field, and this run's own fingerprint records winrate_vs_field as all-zero. Recording a number here would be inventing one.

opponent_gameplan: One-drops that generate energy and life, Ajani and Guide of Souls converting that into a flying clock, with Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment as reach.

opponent_plan.posture_why: Energy one-drops into Guide of Souls build a lifelinking flying clock we cannot outrace, with Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment supplying reach through a stalled board.

key_cards.why: converts every one-drop into life and flying damage, which is why our goldfish loses the race outright
cheap removal that clears a blocker and keeps the clock moving on schedule
sacrifices the board in response to our sweeper, converting a race we were about to reset into damage

primary_gameplan: Survive to a Living End that sacrifices their whole board while we get four bodies, using Anger to buy the turn and Endurance as a free blocker.
pitfalls: Sweeping into an open Goblin Bombardment - they convert the board into damage in response.
Fetching untapped duals on turn one against three Obsidian Charmaw; sequence the basics last only if you can afford it.
Cascading into Living End while they have Vexing Bauble out: the payload is countered and the graveyard is spent.
stance_rationale: Their curve out beats us before turn three on the draw, and Anger exiles rather than kills, which is the only sweeper that does not pay them off.

opposing_sideboard_in.why: kills a nonbasic on curve, and seventeen of our twenty land slots are nonbasic
free, and takes all three Living End the moment one hits the graveyard
counters the cascaded Living End and both free pitch spells, since no mana is spent on any of them
our manabase is three basics deep, so this cuts us off green and blue entirely

play_plan.keep: Double red by turn three, or a hand that cascades on three; anything slower loses to Ocelot Pride.
play_plan.goldfish_for: Anger on the turn they commit the third body, holding cascade mana for the rebuild.
play_plan.watch_for: Goblin Bombardment on the board means they sacrifice in response - sweep before it lands or eat the damage.
play_plan.posture_why: we cannot race a lifelinking start.
